The ordinary financial reading of 'wasted their capex' is failure to recover the investment and its financing costs, not that the assets produce no revenue.

criteria.contradiction_condition: If the revenue antecedent is met, reliable financial records show that the relevant AI capital investment recovered its costs despite annual AI revenue remaining below $2 trillion.
